messages:
jen_partnerships: fyi — AtlasCloud just told us this morning that EU rack lead times moved to 8–10 weeks (was 4–6). They explicitly warned manifests may be split and partial racks could ship. This looks like it could impact Dedicated reservations for several EU customers in July. Can procurement + logistics triage? :warning:

sam_logistics: On it. Do we have updated ETAs per PO/reservation id? @mike_procurement?

mike_procurement: Pulled the PO details. Two affected POs: PO-9753 and PO-9784. Carrier flagged component shortage; they're planning partial shipments if they can't consolidate. If partial, customs timing could diverge.

jen_partnerships: We need to map which Dedicated reservations tie to those POs and prioritize customer commitments. Also, we should consider updating marketplace availability if commits will slip.

tom_eng: If capacity moves, we should prepare routing fallbacks to other regions (e.g., us-west). Ops: what's the cross-region latency impact for affected customers?

alina_cs: I have two enterprise customers flagged (OrionCloud EU and AcmeHealth) — both expect July onboarding. We need an immediate comms plan if dates move.

mike_procurement: Quick mapping command to use locally: ```reservation lookup --po PO-9753 --fields resv_id,region,customer``` For the two POs it returns resv-1223 (eu-west, OrionCloud) and resv-1224 (eu-central, AcmeHealth).

sam_logistics: Atlas sent ETA windows but marked them 'subject to split'. I'm pushing for a consolidated manifest hold request but they said it's a best-effort. Holding request submitted, awaiting response.

jen_partnerships: @mike_procurement can we re-route some racks from our APAC spare pool as a temporary fix? It might be costlier but could save SLAs.

mike_procurement: Possible but needs approval — ballpark incremental cost =~ $9k per rack for reroute (airfreight + customs expedite). Need formal estimate and finance sign-off. cc @carla_finance

carla_finance: Approve up to $25k for emergent reroute to protect enterprise SLAs. Send a short estimate by EOD and I'll formalize the spend.

sam_logistics: If we reroute APAC -> EU by air, transit ~10–12 days plus customs. That could still be faster than waiting for partial consolidation. Need to verify spare pool availability.

jen_partnerships: I'll draft customer messages for both accounts and loop in sales. Also want to mark the marketplace reservations as 'at-risk' to prevent further overcommit.

inventory_bot: Auto-check: reservations resv-1223, resv-1224 flagged as 'pending-shipment' -> updated to 'at-risk' in the console.

tom_eng: Heads-up for ops: please add an auto-fallback policy on the Dedicated routes to route new traffic to us-west when latency tolerance >150ms. I'll open a short PR to the routing config.

jen_partnerships: Thanks all. Action items: Mike - confirm reroute availability + estimate; Sam - keep pressuring Atlas for consolidated manifest; Tom - draft fallback PR; Alina - customer comms. Quick sync at 4pm PT to confirm next steps. :thumbsup:
